organisations: the Greatstone tenant root itself — org_id on every other table points back to this one row
customers: the client organisation table itself — its own id is the customer_id every client-scoped table carries
customer_tiers: catalogue of tier definitions shared by every customer, not a client's own data
users: Greatstone staff accounts — out of scope per GRE-2623, not client data
permissions: global lookup of permission keys shared by every org, not client data
role_permissions: role-to-permission grants for Greatstone staff roles; no client data
user_permissions: per-staff-user permission overrides; no client data
categories: Greatstone's own product/service catalogue taxonomy, not client data
offerings: Greatstone's own catalogue of services/products, not client data
offering_variants: variants of Greatstone's own catalogue offerings, not client data
offering_specs: spec rows on Greatstone's own catalogue offerings, not client data
offering_media: media attached to Greatstone's own catalogue offerings, not client data
pricing_rules: Greatstone's own pricing engine rules, not client data
pricing_rule_targets: targets of Greatstone's own pricing rules, not client data
vendors: Greatstone's own vendor/supplier directory, not client data
media_assets: Greatstone's shared media library, not client data
content_pages: Greatstone's own CMS page content, not client data
page_versions: version history of Greatstone's own CMS pages, not client data
page_status_history: publish-status history of Greatstone's own CMS pages, not client data
import_jobs: Greatstone's own catalogue import job runs, not client data
import_job_rows: row-level results of Greatstone's own catalogue import jobs, not client data
ai_actions: Greatstone staff AI-assisted catalogue edits (org_id = Greatstone); not client data
audit_log: Greatstone staff/admin audit trail (org_id = Greatstone); not client data
fx_rate_history: Greatstone's own FX rate history for pricing, not client data
org_settings: Greatstone's own site settings, not client data
service_popularity: anonymous, cross-visitor aggregate counter keyed by service slug; no client or tenant data
service_popularity_hits: anonymous per-IP rate-limit dedupe rows for the popularity counter; no client or tenant data
front_door_rate: anonymous per-IP rate-limit rows (hashed IP only) for the front-door proposal limiter; no client or tenant data
front_door_leads: pre-sale lead capture before a visitor becomes a customer; no customer_id to carry yet
service_inquiries: pre-sale enquiry capture before a visitor becomes a customer; no customer_id to carry yet
rate_event: anonymous rate-limit bucket keyed by bucket_key/window, not client data
order_items: scoped via order_id (FK to orders, which carries customer_id) — not duplicated here
quote_items: scoped via quote_id (FK to quotes, which carries customer_id) — not duplicated here
auth.users: Supabase Auth system table created by the legacy auth-bridge extension; not application data
storage.buckets: Supabase Storage system table created by the legacy auth-bridge extension; not application data
storage.objects: Supabase Storage system table created by the legacy auth-bridge extension; not application data
better_auth.user: Better Auth's own identity table — the website's one source of truth for a logged-in user's email; access is by session token/userId, not by customer_id
better_auth.session: Better Auth session rows, keyed by userId; access is by session token, not by customer_id
better_auth.account: Better Auth credential/provider rows (incl. the one legitimate password column), keyed by userId; access is by session token, not by customer_id
better_auth.verification: Better Auth email-verification/reset tokens, keyed by identifier; short-lived, not customer-scoped
admin_bridge_nonce: GSAM↔website bridge replay-guard rows; no anon/authenticated/service_role grant, reachable only via the bridge's own role
admin_bridge_audit: GSAM↔website bridge request audit log; no anon/authenticated/service_role grant, reachable only via the bridge's own role
admin_bridge_idempotency: GSAM↔website bridge write-idempotency rows; no anon/authenticated/service_role grant, reachable only via the bridge's own role
admin_bridge_change: GSAM↔website bridge before/after change log; no anon/authenticated/service_role grant, reachable only via the bridge's own role
refund_requests: GSAM-bridge refund workflow rows; owner_all policy only, no anon/authenticated/service_role grant — reachable only via SECURITY DEFINER bridge functions scoped by order_id, not a client-readable surface
interview.person: Better Auth identity above the per-engagement employee row, one per signed-in user (auth_user_id), shared across the organisations a person is interviewed for; holds no client data — per-organisation facts live in interview.employee and interview.memory_blob, which carry customer_id
interview.rate_event: anonymous fixed-window rate-limit counter (bucket_key, window_start, count); no client data
deepdive_findings: no customer_id of its own — staff_all RLS restricts it to staff (org_id = app_staff_org()), and the one client path to a row is via slug -> deepdive_plans.customer_id (1:1), so no client can read another client's rows. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
deepdive_item_state: no customer_id of its own — staff_all RLS restricts it to staff (org_id = app_staff_org()), and the one client path to a row is via slug -> deepdive_plans.customer_id (1:1), so no client can read another client's rows. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
deepdive_log: no customer_id of its own — staff_all RLS restricts it to staff (org_id = app_staff_org()), and the one client path to a row is via slug -> deepdive_plans.customer_id (1:1), so no client can read another client's rows. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
deepdive_files: no customer_id of its own — staff_all RLS restricts it to staff (org_id = app_staff_org()), and the one client path to a row is via slug -> deepdive_plans.customer_id (1:1), so no client can read another client's rows. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
portal_approvers: Greatstone staff approvers, not client data — no anon/authenticated/service_role grant reaches it, so there is no client-readable surface at all. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
mcp_tokens: Greatstone agent credential, not client data — no anon/authenticated/service_role grant reaches the token row itself; per-client scope lives on mcp_token_clients, which carries customer_id. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
mcp_pdf_uploads: no customer_id of its own — no anon/authenticated/service_role grant reaches it, and the one client path to a row is via document_id -> portal_documents.customer_id, so no client can read another client's rows. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
mcp_pdf_chunks: no customer_id of its own — no anon/authenticated/service_role grant reaches it, and the one client path to a row is via document_id -> portal_documents.customer_id, so no client can read another client's rows. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
deep_dive_snapshots: clients can read this table, but RLS policy deep_dive_snapshot_customer joins deep_dive_tenant_links and filters on customer_id = app_customer_id() (1:1 link), so it is correctly client-isolated despite having no customer_id column of its own. Ridge, GRE-2567 step M, 26 Oct 00:00.
